summary: The two acceptance criteria conflict: both specify `slugify("Hello World")` without a separator, but one requires `"hello_world"` and the other requires the existing result `"hello-world"`. I made no changes because the harness says to stop rather than guess when the spec contradicts itself.

questions.title: Which default output should apply?
questions.context: For `slugify("Hello World")` without `separator`, should the result remain `"hello-world"` or change to `"hello_world"`?
